description:
Store configuration

How creator stores work right now: whether they are switched on, the chains a store can run on, what an item on each chain can be priced in besides the store's own token (the chain's coin, a dollar stablecoin), and where the receipt signing keys are published. It also says whether test stores are available here (`testMode`) and whether checkout sessions are (`checkoutSessions`, with the limits on how long one may stay open).
name: get_store_config

checkout.description:
The checkout contract an order with a fee is paid through. Absent on Solana. A hint only: the
contract to pay is always the one in the order's own `payment` block.

checkoutNoFee.description:
The checkout contract an order with no fee is paid through (a store whose `feeBps` is 0). Absent on
Solana and where the chain has none. A hint only, like `checkout`.

confirmations.description: Confirmations an order waits for before it is `confirmed`

currencies.description:
What a SKU on this chain may be paid in besides the store's own token (always allowed, and the
default): the chain's coin and, where the chain has one, its dollar stable.

address.description:
The zero address for an EVM chain's coin, `11111111111111111111111111111111` for SOL, otherwise
the stable's contract or mint

checkoutSessions.description: Present only where checkout sessions are switched on

defaultExpiresInSeconds.description: How long a session stays open when it does not say

fulfilment.description: True where a store's server may report a physical order's fulfilment; absent otherwise

fulfilmentReplacement.description: True where a fulfilment report may carry a replacement (a reprint or a new order for a canceled one); absent otherwise

maxExpiresInSeconds.description: The most `expiresInSeconds` a session may ask for

minExpiresInSeconds.description: The least `expiresInSeconds` a session may ask for

shippingAndTax.description: True where a session for a physical item takes `shippingUsdMicros` and `taxUsdMicros`; absent otherwise

testOnly.description: When true, only a test store's key can open a checkout session here

demoKey.description: Present and true when the demo test key printed in the developer guide works here. Absent, that key answers 401 like an unknown key

paidApps.description:
The limits on what an app can make a buyer pay (paid apps). Chain Daddy may change them at any time.
Amounts are in millionths of a dollar.

confirmAboveUsdMicros.description: Above this, the purchase sheet asks the buyer to press and hold

maxOrderUsdMicros.description: The most one purchase through an app may cost; an app item priced above it cannot be saved

maxQuantity.description: The most units in one order through an app

ordersPerMinute.description: The most orders one buyer wallet may open through one app in a minute

walletAppDayUsdMicros.description: The most one buyer wallet may pay one app in any 24 hours

solanaStaticKey.description: The read-only account every Solana store payment references

testMode.description:
Whether test stores are available here: a store's test store, its `cd_iap_test_` keys, and paying a
test order with no money

title: Get creator store settings
